reasoning: This gazette contains multiple notices under Section 10 A (1) (A) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of the Colombo Municipal Council due to ceasing to be members of the United National Party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials in local government, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7).
